description: Polyphonic slew limiter that caps how fast the input can change, with separate rise and fall times and shapes, plus gates reporting the slope

params.text: Switches the rise and fall time knobs to a much faster range, suited to slewing audio rate inputs
Sets oversampling to off, x2, x4, x8, x16 or x32, which matters when the input is audio
Sets the milliseconds taken to rise 10V: 7.8125ms fully counter-clockwise, 250ms at noon, 8000ms fully clockwise, or 0.060223ms to 61.155ms with FAST on
Sets the milliseconds taken to fall 10V: 7.8125ms fully counter-clockwise, 250ms at noon, 8000ms fully clockwise, or 0.060223ms to 61.155ms with FAST on
Inverts and attenuates the rise time CV, -100% to 100%, at 0% by default
Inverts and attenuates the fall time CV, -100% to 100%, at 0% by default
Sets how curved the rise is, linear fully counter-clockwise and 100% curve fully clockwise; a curved rise moves large changes faster than small ones
Sets how curved the fall is, linear fully counter-clockwise and 100% curve fully clockwise; a curved fall moves large changes faster than small ones
Inverts and attenuates the rise shape CV, -100% to 100%
Inverts and attenuates the fall shape CV, -100% to 100%
Switches the rise, fall and flat gate outputs between 0-10V and -5V to +5V

inputs.text: Modulates the rise time through its attenuverter; each volt doubles the time and each negative volt halves it
Modulates the fall time through its attenuverter; each volt doubles the time and each negative volt halves it
Modulates the rise curve through its attenuverter at 10% curve per volt, summed with the knob
Modulates the fall curve through its attenuverter at 10% curve per volt, summed with the knob
The raw signal to be slewed
Scales both the rise and fall times with pitch: each volt halves them and each negative volt doubles them

outputs.text: A gate that goes high while the slewed output is rising and low the rest of the time
A gate that goes high while the slewed output is falling and low the rest of the time
A gate that goes high while the slewed output is steady and low the rest of the time

menu: Oversampled slope sensitivity (min delta) — the smallest voltage change per sample the gate outputs will count: 10mV, 1mV, 0.1mV, 0.01mV or 0.001mV, to trim gate noise on audio
Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
